items.title: 11.4 Dil aur naliyon ke amraz (cardiovascular disorders) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.4, printed pages 246-249.

blocks.text: Cardiovascular amraz (disorders) taraqqi-yafta aur taraqqi-pazeer mulkon mein maut ka sab se bara sabab hain. Yeh khoon ki naliyon aur dil ke amraz hain, aur atherosclerosis aur arteriosclerosis in ke bare sabab hain.

items: Atherosclerosis ka matlab arteries ke andar jamao hai. Arteries mein mukhtalif maddey jama ho sakte hain: charbi wale maddey, smooth muscle cells ki ghair-mamooli miqdar, cholesterol, fibrin aur mukhtalif qism ka cellular malba (debris). Yeh sab jamao arteries ke theek kaam mein rukawat dalte hain, aur cholesterol ka jamao bunyadi sabab samjha jata hai. Atherosclerosis dil ke daure (heart attack) tak le ja sakti hai, kyunke yeh arteries ko tang karti aur thrombus banne ka khatra barhati hai.

Arteriosclerosis ka matlab arteries ki deewaron ka sakht hona hai. Yeh tab hoti hai jab arteries ki deewaron mein calcium jama ho; in arteries se khoon ka bahao mehdood ho jata hai aur woh mamool ke mutabiq phail nahin saktin, jo dil ko zyada mehnat par majboor karta hai. Shadeed atherosclerosis aam taur par arteriosclerosis tak le jati hai.

blocks.text: Cardiovascular mareezon par asal masla dhundne aur beemari ki shiddat napne ke liye mukhtalif tashkhisi tests kiye jate hain; aham ECG aur angiography hain. Coronary angiography dil ki khoon ki naliyon ya khanon ka X-ray muaina hai. Doctor ek chhota nali-numa aala, catheter, jism ki bari arteries se guzarta hai; jab us ka sira coronary arteries ke munh tak pohnchta hai to ek khaas mayah (contrast medium ya dye) jo X-ray machine ko nazar aata hai catheter se dala jata hai, aur coronary artery mein mayah ki tasveerein (angiograms) li jati hain. Agar coronary artery ke lumen mein clots hon to artery tang nazar aati hai. Tashkhisi catheter ko guiding catheter se badal kar doctor catheter ke zariye coronary artery mein aala bhi daal sakte hain; sab se aam aale guide wires aur balloon dilation catheters hain.

Thrombosis thrombus ka banna hai, yani khoon ki nali mein khoon ke ajza ka thos lothra ya dat (clot), jo nali ko poora ya juzvi taur par band kar sakta hai. Thrombus khoon ki naliyon ki tah ki khush-khush ya infection, tawil be-amli se khoon ke bahao ki kam raftar, ya pneumonia, tuberculosis aur emphysema jaisi beemariyon se ban sakta hai. Thrombosis aza tak khoon ka bahao rokti hai: coronary arteries mein thrombosis dil ka daura karti hai, aur dimagh ki naliyon mein thrombus falij (stroke) karta hai. Thrombus ukhar kar daurani nizam mein kisi aur jagah ja sakta hai; aisa thrombus embolus hai, aur thrombus ka banna aur kahin aur le jaya jana thromboembolism hai.

Coronary arteries cardiac muscle ko oxygen aur nutrients deti hain. Agar un mein khoon ka bahao rukta hai to cardiac muscle ke ek ya zyada hisson ko na-kafi khoon milta hai, aur agar oxygen aur nutrients ki kami se dil ke pathe mar jayen to yeh kaifiyat myocardial infarction, dil ka daura, hai. Coronary arteries ka band hona aam taur par coronary artery ki andarooni deewar mein lipids, khaas kar cholesterol, ke batadreej jamao se hota hai. Agar yeh halaat jari rahen to dabao ya jismani mushaqqat ke dauran seene ka dard, angina pectoris, ho sakta hai; angina batati hai ke oxygen ki talab us ki faraahmi se zyada hai aur mustaqbil mein dil ka daura ho sakta hai. Agar tarz-e-zindagi ki tabdeeli aur dawaon se alamat door na hon, ya tang coronary arteries par dil ke daure ka fauri khatra ho, to coronary bypass surgery ya angioplasty ki jati hai.

blocks.title: Sehatyabi aur khatra
blocks.text: Dil ke daure se sehatyabi mumkin hai agar dil ka kharab hissa itna chhota ho ke dil ki doosri khoon ki naliyan apni gunjaish barha kar kharab tissue ko dobara khoon de sakein. Dil ki beemari aur coronary artery ki beemari taraqqi-yafta mulkon mein maut ke bare asbab hain.

Coronary bypass surgery cardiac muscle tak khoon ki rukawat ka azala karne ke sab se aam aur moassar tareeqon mein se hai. Surgeon mareez ki taang, bazu, seene ya pait se ek sehatmand khoon ki nali leta hai aur us ke sire band coronary artery ke oopar aur neeche jorta hai, taake khoon kharab ya band hisse ke gird se guzar jaye. Khula ya dharakte dil ki surgery us waqt ki jati hai jab dil dharak raha ho. Bypass surgery bunyadi beemari, atherosclerosis ya coronary artery disease, ka ilaj nahin karti: tarz-e-zindagi ki tabdeeliyan, khaas kar smoking chhorna, kamyab surgery ke baad bhi aainda rukawaton aur dil ke dauron ka imkan kam karne ke liye nihayat aham hain, aur mareezon ko khoorak mein kuch qism ki charbi kam karna, jismani sargarmi barhana, aur zyada khoon ke dabao, diabetes aur dil ki beemari ke doosre khatre ke awamil qaboo karna bhi hota hai.

blocks.alt: Dil jis ke saamne coronary artery neeche jati hai aur ek graft nali aorta se artery ke ek box wale hisse ke neeche tak jori gai hai. Box bara kar ke: coronary artery peeli jamawat (deposit) se band hai, aur narangi bypass graft artery se rukawat ke oopar aur neeche jura hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Khoon rukawat wali jagah ko chhor kar graft ke raste aage chala jata hai, is liye dil ka woh hissa phir se khoon pata hai.

Angioplasty woh tareeqa hai jo band ya tang artery kholta hai. Ek chhoti taar, catheter, X-ray ki rehnumai mein tang coronary artery se guzari jati hai, aur ek chhota sausage ki shakal ka ghubbara (balloon) taar par tang hisse mein pohncha kar use phailane ke liye phulaya jata hai; artery phail jaye to kamyab phailao ki tasdeeq ke liye thora sa dye dala jata hai. Angioplasty ke dauran stenting bhi ho sakti hai: stent balloon catheter par laga stainless steel ki jali (mesh) ki phailne wali nali hai. Jab stent aur balloon tang artery ke andar rakh diye jayen to balloon phulaya jata hai, jo stent aur artery ko phailata hai; balloon nikal liya jata hai aur stent apni jagah rehta hai, artery ki deewaron ko sahara deta aur artery ko khula aur phaila rakhta hai.

blocks.alt: Tang artery ke teen number-shuda manzar. 1: catheter ek pichka hua balloon aur us par stent artery mein le jata hai, jahan plaque lumen ko tang karta hai. 2: balloon phulaya gaya, stent phail gaya aur plaque deewar se dab gaya. 3: balloon nikal liya gaya aur stent wahin reh kar artery ko khula rakhta hai.

blocks.text: Khoon ke dabao ka chronic (tawil) barhna hypertension hai, jo tab hoti hai jab khoon ka dabao musalsal 140/90 se oopar rahe. Khoon ke dabao ke aasabi ya hormonal intizam ki koi bhi kharabi ise kar sakti hai; doosre asbab mein dabao (stress), motapa, zyada namak lena aur smoking shamil hain, aur mauroosi (hereditary) wajoohat bhi ho sakti hain. Jab bhi khoon ka dabao chronic taur par barha ho to khoon ki naliyon ke phatne ka imkan barh jata hai; dimagh mein aisa ho to yeh brain haemorrhage hai, jo dimagh ki nazuk banawat ko nuqsan pohnchata hai. Hypertension cardiac muscle ko bhi kamzor karti hai: agar yeh tawil ho to dil moassar taur par pump nahin kar pata aur tissues ki zaroorat ke mutabiq khoon ka bahao qaim nahin reh sakta, to khoon dil aur phephron mein ruk sakta hai, congestive heart failure mein. Hypertension gurdon ke nephrons ko bhi nuqsan pohncha sakti hai, jo khoon mein namak aur pani ki mazeed rukawat aur is liye mazeed hypertension tak le jata hai.

blocks.title: Seene ka dard aur heart failure
blocks.text: Congestive heart failure ke dauran seene ka dard, angina samet, nahin hota.

blocks.prompt: Ek mareez ko seerhiyan charhne par angina hoti hai, aur angiogram ek coronary artery cholesterol se tang dikhata hai. Muqabla karein ke stent ke saath angioplasty aur bypass surgery har ek kya karegi, aur batayein ke dono kya ilaj nahin kartin.
blocks.explanation: Angioplasty catheter ko tang hisse mein pohnchati hai, use phailane ko balloon phulati hai, aur artery khuli rakhne ko phailaya hua stainless steel stent chhor deti hai. Bypass surgery taang, bazu, seene ya pait se sehatmand nali le kar use rukawat ke oopar aur neeche jorti hai taake khoon us ke gird se guzre. Dono us atherosclerosis ka ilaj nahin kartin jis ne tangi ki, is liye mareez ko nai rukawaton se bachne ke liye smoking chhorni, charbi kam karni, warzish karni aur khoon ka dabao aur diabetes qaboo karne honge.

items: Atherosclerosis (charbi, cholesterol, fibrin, muscle cells aur malbe ka jamao) arteries tang karti aur thrombi ko dawat deti hai; arteriosclerosis (calcium) unhen sakht karti hai. Thrombus nali band karta hai; ukhra hua embolus hai; coronary arteries mein nateeja dil ka daura, dimagh mein falij.

Angiography: catheter coronary arteries mein X-ray ko nazar aane wala dye daal kar tangi dikhata hai. Angina pectoris aane wale myocardial infarction ki khabardari hai. Ilaj: coronary bypass (rukawat ke gird graft) aur stent ke saath angioplasty (balloon), tarz-e-zindagi ki tabdeeli ke saath, khaas kar smoking chhorna.

Hypertension musalsal 140/90 se oopar dabao hai, kharab intizam, stress, motape, namak, smoking ya wirasat se; yeh brain haemorrhage, congestive heart failure aur gurde ke nuqsan ka khatra rakhti hai.
